plugins.name: idle-stop
plugins.description: Stops a server when its last player leaves, plus a live player list, kick, ban, ban list, clear-bans/clear-session reset and on-join welcome messages. Supports Source/GoldSrc (A2S/RCON), Minecraft (RCON), Valheim (ValheimRcon), Palworld, Project Zomboid (Source-RCON) and Nuclear Option (TCP remote commands).
plugins.author: SpiritNetworks
